name: Dillard's Mastercard®
balance_transfer_apr: 32.74%, for balance transfers completed within 4 months of account opening
balance_transfer_fee: The greater of $10 or 5% of the amount of each transfer
late_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another late payment occurs within 6 billing cycles
returned_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another returned payment occurs within 6 billing cycles

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $100 on the day of account approval

verdict.text: Thin rewards and high APR: only for Dillard's regulars who pay in full

earn_rates.category: All other purchases where Mastercard is accepted

earn_note: This is the open-loop Mastercard version of Dillard's card: it earns outside Dillard's, unlike the closed-loop, store-only Dillard's Credit Card, which earns the same 2 pts/$1 at Dillard's but nothing anywhere else. The 2 pts/$1 at Dillard's covers stores, dillards.com, phone orders and the Dillard's app. Gas and grocery purchases earn only 1 pt/$1 when paid through a mobile or digital wallet, a mobile card reader, a third-party payment account or an online marketplace, and superstores and warehouse clubs may not code as supermarkets. Points expire 12 months after you earn them. Both card products are issued by Citibank, N.A.

redemption_options.method: Every 1,500 points converts to a $10 Reward Certificate or a 10% Off Shopping Pass (the default), redeemable at Dillard's and dillards.com. At most 4 certificates or 1 pass per billing cycle, and 48 certificates or 12 passes a year

points.per_100k: About $667–$1,000 in Dillard's rewards, depending on whether points are redeemed as $10 certificates or 10%-off passes
points.note: Rewards redeem only at Dillard's: no cash, statement credit, or gift cards. At 1,500 points = $10, the 2 pts/$1 rate at Dillard's, gas and groceries works out to roughly 1.3% back, and the 1 pt/$1 base rate to about 0.67%, both well below a typical flat-rate cash-back card. Points expire 12 months after they're earned, and certificates and passes at least 60 days after they're issued.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: Dillard's Rewards points redeem only at Dillard's.

insurance.detail: Not confirmed on Citi's or Dillard's public product pages for this card
Not confirmed on Citi's or Dillard's public product pages for this card

protection_note: Citi publishes no Guide to Benefits for this card, and its product page lists no purchase protection, extended warranty, or travel insurance. Treat this as a rewards-and-financing card with no insurance you can count on.
rental_note: No rental car coverage found for this card.

services.name: Special financing offers
services.detail: In-store-only (not online) promotional financing periodically offered on qualifying Dillard's purchases; check current terms before financing.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns rewards on their spend (into your account)
No dedicated insurance to share: this card doesn't carry a confirmed protection suite

additional_cards.note: Free to add, useful mainly for pooling a household's Dillard's/gas/grocery spend toward the redemption thresholds.

timeline.text: Dillard's signed a new card program agreement with Citibank, effective Jan 26, 2024, moving both the store-only Dillard's Credit Card and this Dillard's Mastercard to Citi from the previous issuer.

Dillard's/Citi issue two distinct card products: the closed-loop, store-only Dillard's Credit Card (2 pts/$1 at Dillard's, unusable elsewhere) and this open-loop Dillard's Mastercard (same 2 pts/$1 at Dillard's/gas/groceries, plus 1 pt/$1 everywhere else Mastercard is accepted). Confirm which one you're comparing; they are not the same card.
